description: Add objective families gradually. Actual family coefficients are equal within each case. Positive relative weights still sum to one, while positive_scale makes their absolute coefficients comparable with penalties.

common.reward_normalization: Active objective families receive equal absolute coefficients. The delay family is the mean of deadline, max-wait, and population-wait risks.

cases.label: R0: throughput
cases.hypothesis: Reference policy for maximum goodput pressure.

cases.label: R1: throughput + Jain
cases.hypothesis: Equal throughput and Jain coefficients reveal the direct two-objective trade-off.

cases.label: R2: add starvation
cases.hypothesis: Throughput, Jain fairness, and starvation each receive coefficient one third.

cases.label: R3: add delay family
cases.hypothesis: Throughput, Jain, starvation, and aggregate delay each receive coefficient one quarter.

cases.label: R4a: add PF utility
cases.hypothesis: PF utility is added as a fifth equal family without adding other fairness proxies.

cases.label: R4b: add deficit service
cases.hypothesis: Deficit service is added as a fifth equal family and compared directly with PF utility.

cases.label: R4c: add low throughput
cases.hypothesis: Bottom-throughput pressure is added as a fifth equal family and compared with PF and deficit service.
